subject: Quick correction on tonight
text:
Okay, I owe everyone an apology. I looked at the shared calendar and somehow convinced myself the assignment review was Friday afternoon, not tonight. That explains my blank face when the reminder popped up.

Can we still meet, even if it is a little later than planned? I have my notes and a few questions, but I can also reschedule if tonight has already become totally awkward for everyone. Sorry again.
